identityRequired: Enter your account or current password and a valid email first
unavailable: This account service is unavailable. Check the tenant or contact your administrator.
registered: Account created. Sign in; business access is assigned by your administrator.
passwordReset: Password reset. Please sign in again.
recoverySent: If the account matches a verified email, a message will arrive. The code is valid for {minutes} minutes.
mailScope: System administrators manage this shared mail service for all tenants. Disabling it pauses registration, email verification and password recovery.
mailReady: Mail service is configured and enabled
mailNotReady: Mail is disabled or incomplete. Ask a system administrator to configure it before enabling account services.
test_untested: Current configuration has not been tested
testHint: Save before testing. SMTP acceptance does not guarantee inbox delivery; also check spam.
emailUnverified: Email is unverified and cannot be used for password recovery.
mailUnavailable: Mail service is unavailable. Contact your administrator.
